<summary>
### 1. Task Overview
- **User Request:** Transform the Mission Control application UI to match the exact aesthetic, brightness, and color palette of the Obsidian prototype ([prototypes/obsidian/index.html](file:///d:/Downloads/Mission-Control-2.19.0-Full-App-UI-Redesign/nvkh-main/prototypes/obsidian/index.html) and [prototypes/obsidian/obsidian.css](file:///d:/Downloads/Mission-Control-2.19.0-Full-App-UI-Redesign/nvkh-main/prototypes/obsidian/obsidian.css), linked from [MISSION-CONTROL-OBSIDIAN.html](file:///d:/Downloads/Mission-Control-2.19.0-Full-App-UI-Redesign/nvkh-main/MISSION-CONTROL-OBSIDIAN.html)).
- **Explicit Constraints & Scope Boundaries:**
  - **Do NOT change** the functional behavior, DOM structure, or controls of **Workspace, Needs You, History, and Integrations**. Only update their color palette and surfaces to match the Obsidian theme.
  - **Groundstation View** must specifically look like the Obsidian Groundstation prototype (ambient 3-point glow, glassmorphism cards, briefing banner with circular glow, metrics cluster, segmented controls, status pills).
  - **Add Terminal Dialog (`WorkerDialog.jsx`)** must specifically match the Obsidian dialog box (20px border radius, `rgba(25, 32, 41, 0.97)` glass background, `blur(30px)` with `rgba(3, 6, 11, 0.65)` backdrop, frosted inputs `#080c125c`, mint toggle highlights, sticky footer, and silver-white button `linear-gradient(#eef3f6, #d5dfe5)` with `#192128` text).

### 2. Progress
- **Baseline Verification:**
  - Ran `npm run groundstation:build` — passed cleanly.
  - Ran `npm run test` — all 544 tests passed with zero failures.
- **Implementation Plan:**
  - Created `implementation_plan.md` artifact which was explicitly reviewed and approved by the user.
- **Styling Updates Completed:**
  1. `src/groundstation/renderer/redesign/tokens-bridge.css`:
     - Updated canonical scale: `--mc-void: #0b0e13`, `--mc-canvas: #0e1319`, `--mc-surface: #12171e`, `--mc-surface-2: #1b222b`, `--mc-border: rgba(195, 211, 228, 0.11)`, `--mc-border-strong: rgba(225, 237, 249, 0.20)`.
     - Updated glass tiers (`--mc-glass-popover: rgba(25, 32, 41, 0.97)`, `--mc-glass-card: rgba(17, 23, 31, 0.73)`).
     - Updated text colors (`--mc-text: #eef2f6`, `--mc-text-muted: #b0bac6`, `--mc-text-dim: #95a2b1`, `--mc-text-ink: #192128`).
     - Updated semantic accents (`--mc-ok: #a9ddc4`, `--mc-warning: #edc58b`, `--mc-danger: #f2a7ae`, `--mc-accent: #a9ddc4`, `--mc-ai` & `--mc-info: #afc6f3`).
     - Updated legacy token compatibility aliases (`--green-500: #a9ddc4`, `--blue-500: #afc6f3`, `--mc-accent-soft: rgba(169, 221, 196, 0.12)`).
  2. `src/groundstation/renderer/tokens.css`:
     - Synchronized root variables with Obsidian palette for backwards compatibility.
  3. `src/groundstation/renderer/redesign/base.css`:
     - Updated `html body` background and radial ambient glow to match Obsidian's 3-point ambient lighting (`#54665330` mint, `#354c632a` navy, `#8b9bbd16` slate).
  4. `src/groundstation/renderer/redesign/surfaces.css`:
     - Overhauled overlay backdrop and modal dialog container to 20px radius, `rgba(25, 32, 41, 0.97)` with `blur(30px)` and subtle bevel.
     - Fully restyled `.worker-dialog` (`WorkerDialog.jsx`): header with mint eyebrow, close button, segmented pill tabs, 3-step guide with mint badges, template cards with mint selected highlight, form fields with frosted background `#080c125c`, mint toggle switch tracks, sticky footer, and silver-white primary button (`linear-gradient(#eef3f6, #d5dfe5)` with `#192128` text).
     - Updated global primary buttons in `surfaces.css` to silver-white gradient with `#192128` ink text.
  5. `src/groundstation/renderer/redesign/cockpit.css`:
     - Updated primary button override rules to silver-white gradient with `#192128` ink text.
  6. `src/groundstation/renderer/redesign/screens.css`:
     - Updated `.mc-ref-groundstation` container background to `transparent !important` to reveal ambient lighting.
     - Updated `.mc-gs-statusbar` to Obsidian frosted glass `rgba(11, 14, 19, 0.75)` with `blur(24px)`.
     - Updated `.mc-gs-attention` (attention briefing) and `.mc-gs-attention.is-clear` (clear briefing) to Obsidian briefing cards with mint/amber gradients and glowing circular pill badges.

### 3. Key Findings
- The application architecture loads redesign CSS in a strict order in `main.jsx`: `tokens-bridge.css` -> `base.css` -> `workspace.css` -> `screens.css` -> `cockpit.css` -> `surfaces.css`.
- `cockpit.css` re-declares several properties on `#root#root .shell` to enforce specificity over legacy layers like `premiumV3.css` and `premiumDesign.css`. Any button or surface overrides must be consistent between `surfaces.css` and `cockpit.css`.
- Groundstation's operations register (`.mc-gs-register`, `.mc-ref-manifest`) and lower grid panels (`.mc-ref-lower-grid .mc-ref-panel`) are styled in `screens.css` around lines 1230–1650.

### 4. Active Context
- All edits to `tokens-bridge.css`, `tokens.css`, `base.css`, `surfaces.css`, and `cockpit.css` have been saved.
- Currently in `screens.css`: briefing banners and status bar are updated; remaining sections in `screens.css` are the Groundstation operations register card, toolbar search/chips, table row hover/borders, and lower grid cards (recent activity, recipes, mission graph).

### 5. Next Steps
1. **Finish Groundstation visual styling in `src/groundstation/renderer/redesign/screens.css`:**
   - Lines ~1230-1340: Update `.mc-gs-register` and `.mc-ref-manifest` to Obsidian `.panel` style (`background: rgba(17, 23, 31, 0.73)`, border `rgba(195, 211, 228, 0.11)`, border-radius `14px`, box-shadow `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)`).
   - Lines ~1265-1325: Update `.mc-gs-chips` and `.mc-gs-search` to matching translucent pill controls.
   - Lines ~1340-1510: Update manifest rows (`.mc-ref-manifest-row`) and status badges (`.mc-ref-status`) to match Obsidian pill styles (`.pill.running`, `.pill.failed`, `.pill.pending`).
   - Lines ~1530-1650: Update `.mc-ref-lower-grid .mc-ref-panel` to Obsidian glass card styling with refined typography and dividers.
2. **Verify Workspace, Needs You, History, and Integrations:**
   - Confirm in `workspace.css` that terminal panes (`#0c1017` / `#12171e`, active terminal border `#a9ddc4`) and text inherit the Obsidian palette properly while preserving all functionality.
   - Confirm Needs You and History event rows render with the new token colors without breaking any layout.
3. **Build & Test Validation:**
   - Run `npm run groundstation:build` to confirm Vite builds without syntax errors.
   - Run `npm run test` to ensure all 544 tests continue passing.
4. **Create Walkthrough:**
   - Write `walkthrough.md` documenting the visual transformation and verification results.

### 6. Commitments & Constraints
- Under no circumstances should the functional logic, React state, or DOM structure of Workspace, Needs You, History, or Integrations be altered. Only color palette and surface visual variables apply to them.
- Add Terminal dialog and Groundstation view must faithfully mirror the Obsidian design language down to the exact hex codes, glass opacities, and border radii.
</summary>
